verdict.rationale: Runpod documents custom containers pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR) and lets you launch a Pod with your own image via `runpodctl pod create --image`. Templates are described as pre-configured Docker image setups, and you can manage them through the CLI, REST API and GraphQL API; the REST API also covers registries. A community user reports deploying third-party templates in a few clicks, but there is no independent hands-on report of running a self-built image. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on authoring a custom template (env vars, ports, start commands), explicit documentation of private-registry authentication, and independent hands-on corroboration of running a self-built image.
